items.title: Vaccines take center stage at federal autism advisory committee
items.summary: Comments about vaccines overshadowed an advisory committee meeting to discuss a plan for boosting federal funding for autism research.

items.title: Spyre tumbles as immune drug misses mark in rheumatoid arthritis
items.summary: The results erased more than $1 billion in market value and raised questions about how impactful drugs that block the TL1A protein might be against the condition.

items.title: Biohaven trades cash for ‘upside’ with $795M epilepsy drug deal
